output.subject: We've received your message about the Wexford Commons branch
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us about the Wexford Commons branch. We can tell how much this branch means to you, and we're grateful you took the time to share your concerns.

We have received your complaint, and we want to make sure we have understood it:

- You told us you feel it is unfair to close the Wexford Commons branch, and that you can get there easily because the bus goes right past it.
- You mentioned that the next closest branch is two buses away, and that you can't stand for that long.
- You told us you have done your banking at Wexford Commons since you and your husband moved to the area.
- You have asked us to reconsider closing the branch.

A specialist team is now reviewing your message, and we will respond to you within 10 business days. If anything has changed or there is more you would like us to know in the meantime, please reply to this email.

We're sorry for the worry this has caused you, and thank you again for letting us know how this affects you.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: A redacted token garbled one sentence in the complaint (it reads 'I'm ⟦ADDRESS_1⟧ymore'). It likely refers to how the customer travels, so check the original if available. The draft leaves it out.
The customer describes a mobility limitation (can't stand long enough for a two-bus trip). Consider whether accessibility or vulnerable-customer support should be offered.
Confirm the current status and timing of the Wexford Commons closure before any substantive reply.
Decide how to respond to the request to reconsider the closure. The draft takes no position.
Consider whether to mention alternative ways to bank or accessible options. None are described in the draft.
